subject: Ground transit: Workshop day — staging, shuttles, and parking passes
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Green <olivia@quadrantevents.com>, venue@theplexevents.com
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Ground transit: Workshop day — staging, shuttles, and parking passes

Team + Olivia —

Quick recap and asks for the Aug 31 enterprise workshop at The Plex (Downtown): we expect ~160 attendees, 8 panelists, and 12 on-site staff/AV crew. Key objectives:
- Secure a staging area for 2 shuttle buses and 6 car-service vehicles for guest drop-off (7:30–8:45am peak).
- Reserve 50 parking passes for attendees (venue lot + overflow lot) and 6 passes for rental/AV vehicles all day.
- Confirm ADA-accessible vehicles and one stretcher-capable vehicle for speaker A.
- Provide a meet-and-greet point (hotel-side entrance) and a driver check-in table with radio/walkie contact.
- Provide a quoted invoice and an itemized rate-card we can attach to the vendor PO.

Please reply with: staging coordinates on the site map, loading/unloading procedures (for large equipment), driver contact numbers, and a draft invoice by EOD so we can route to procurement. Priya, Marcus — can you review the map and confirm the preferred overflow lot?

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Events Program Manager | Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0172

[attachment: workshop_agenda.pdf (PDF, 240KB)]

From: Olivia Green <olivia@quadrantevents.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: venue@theplexevents.com
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ground transit: Workshop day — staging, shuttles, and parking passes

Hi Diego / team —

Thanks for the details. Attached is a proposed site map with staging and two shuttle loops called out, plus a preliminary rate card and parking pass workbook. Highlights:
- Staging: Lot C (north loading dock) can hold 2 buses and up to 8 sedans; recommended shuttle pickup is the curb outside Entrance B (hotel drop-off).
- Shuttle cadence: every 12 minutes between 7:30–9:00am, then on-demand 11:30–1:30pm return windows. We can add an evening shuttle if needed.
- ADA: We will reserve one ramp-equipped minibus and one stretcher-capable vehicle; we've flagged driver Jorge R. as point for accessibility needs.
- Loading: heavy AV trucks should use Dock 4 (backstage) with a 15-minute unload window; dock staff will run a radio monitor at channel 6.
- Pricing: shuttle loop (round trip) $180 per loop; car service (per vehicle) $65/hr (includes 15% staffing surcharge for early staging); parking passes $12 each (venue lot).

I attached site_map.pdf, vendor_rate_card.pdf, and parking_passes.xlsx. Ben Turner from CityCar is looping in to provide the driver roster and confirm contract language.

Olivia Green
Senior Account Manager, Quadrant Events
O: 617-555-3434 | M: 617-555-9102

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Olivia Green <olivia@quadrantevents.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ground transit: Workshop day — staging, shuttles, and parking passes

Quick notes from procurement/ops perspective:
- Lot C works for staging but we prefer Overflow Lot F for attendee parking to avoid morning congestion near Entrance A. Marcus — confirm if Lot F adds a 6–8 minute shuttle leg that’s acceptable.
- Can you change the rate card to show bundled pricing for: 2 shuttles + 6 sedans for an 8-hour day (we prefer a daily bundle vs hourly). That'll simplify the PO.
- Need the invoice to include Quadrant Events' FedTax ID and a line for "Event-day access passes".

If Olivia/Ben can supply the driver roster and a sample invoice, I can submit the PO by Friday.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan
Program Operations | Redwood Inference

Diego / team —

Ben from CityCar here. Attached is the driver_roster.csv and a short operations memo. Logistics notes:
- Driver check-in: we'll set up a driver table at Entrance B with QR check-in (driver list + assigned vehicle plates).
- Radios: we will equip lead drivers and dock supervisor with Channel 6 handsets; backup contact is my cell (978-555-2200).
- Vehicle IDs: we will supply window placards that read "Redwood Workshop — Shuttle" for quick traffic direction.
- Billing: we can issue a consolidated invoice to Redwood; add a 2% processing fee for same-day changes after Aug 25.

Attached: driver_roster.csv and citycar_ops_memo.pdf. Let me know if you want names redacted for public materials.

Cheers,

Perfect — thanks everyone. Next steps:
1) Olivia: please update the rate-card to include the daily bundle (2 shuttles + 6 sedans) and a separate line for 6 AV/rental vehicle passes, then send a draft invoice with your FedTax ID.
2) Ben: confirm final driver roster by Aug 25 and send vehicle plate numbers. We'll publish the driver contact list to the onsite ops doc (internal only).
3) Priya/Marcus: confirm Overflow Lot F for attendee parking by EOD tomorrow; if approved, we'll ask Olivia to print 50 passes from parking_passes.xlsx.

Assume approval to proceed on staging at Lot C pending Lot F confirmation. Olivia/Ben — please send invoices to ops-purchase@redwood.com and cc me. I will handle the on-site signage and the driver check-in table layout.

Diego
(415) 555-0172
